newsitem.title: USA: Life Medical starts scar treatment study. [CORRECTED]
newsitem.headline: Life Medical starts scar treatment study. [CORRECTED]

text.p: Life Medical Sciences Inc said on Tuesday it began a controlled, blinded clinical study for Scar Care, its scar management device.

In conjunction with the study, the company said it would make a 510K submission to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration, and it expected approval for the product by the second quarter 1997. A 510K is a request for an exemption the normal FDA marketing approval process, the company said.
The study, to be completed by the second quarter, would examine the ability of the device to diminish cosmetic disfigurement and discomfort from hypertrophic and keloid scars, the company said.
These scars resulted from injuries or surgeries.
President and Chief Exexcutive (corrects from Financial) Officer Robert Hickey said Life Medical's ultimate goal was to see if the device could be used to prevent the formation of such scars.
